title: After 10 years at United, CEO Scott Kirby is thinking big about the future of his airline from JFK to AI
summary_full: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby talked to CNBC in a wide-ranging interview about his proposed airline megadeals, AI and the future of the carrier.
